mapper.sql: from ACT_HI_TASKINST t join workflow_business_apply a on a.process_instance_id = t.PROC_INST_ID_
mapper.select:
select t.ID_ as taskId, t.NAME_ as taskName, t.TASK_DEF_KEY_ as taskDefinitionKey, t.PROC_INST_ID_ as processInstanceId, t.ASSIGNEE_ as assigneeKey, t.START_TIME_ as createTime, t.CLAIM_TIME_ as claimTime, t.END_TIME_ as endTime, t.DELETE_REASON_ as deleteReason, a.id as applyId, a.business_key as businessKey, a.apply_status as applyStatus, a.process_name as processName, a.process_definition_key as processKey, t.PROC_DEF_ID_ as processDefinitionId, coalesce(a.applicant_dept_id, a.org_id) as orgId, case when exists ( select 1 from workflow_task_record r where r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and r.process_instance_id = a.process_instance_id and r.action = 'RETURN' ) then 1 else 0 end as returned, case when exists ( select 1 from workflow_task_record rt where rt.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and rt.task_id = t.ID_ and rt.action = 'RETURN' ) then 1 else 0 end as taskReturned, (select max(rl.created_time) from workflow_task_record rl where rl.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and rl.process_instance_id = a.process_instance_id and rl.action = 'RETURN') as lastReturnAt, (select rv.variables_json from workflow_task_record rv where rv.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and rv.process_instance_id = a.process_instance_id and rv.action = 'RETURN' order by rv.created_time desc, rv.id desc limit 1) as lastReturnVariables
order by
case when t.CLAIM_TIME_ is null then 1 else 0 end asc, t.CLAIM_TIME_
case when t.END_TIME_ is null then 1 else 0 end asc, t.END_TIME_
t.START_TIME_
asc desc
, t.ID_ asc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
